items.title: Albert Glenny Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I went out there with Lawrence. Morato. ... He stopped playing with Joyce Lewis. ... that boy was a bass player.

ctx.x: He went to double R. I'd like to see him sometime. You can see him. Oh yeah. Did you sick to go to sea? Huh? I don't know. He told me he was very sick.

I went out there with Lawrence. Morato. Morato. Morato. Morato. Yes, he's back. Huh? I know. He stopped playing with Joyce Lewis. I know. He was kind of his heart. Yes. I'm going to learn his part how to play bass. Bill Morato. Is that right? That boy, that old man with the bass player, he beat me. I don't say like somebody, I'm going to learn it. But that boy was a bass player. Yeah, that's just the truth, you know. The truth is the light. Sure.
Absolutely. Sure. What sort of places did you play with Robert Charles' band? Yeah. Yeah.
